title: Group around prototyping table at DREAMLab
objects_and_counts: At least ten people are visible standing around a central work table; several faces are partially obscured by other people or by the table edges.
One large red, torpedo- or hull-shaped prototype device sits on the table near the right-center of the image (cropped on the right edge).
One handheld flashlight on the table is turned on and emitting light toward the left side of the image.
One black plastic basket containing hand tools and small electronic components is on the table near the foreground center.
One magnifying glass on a stand is visible near the right-front edge of the table.
One cylindrical clear container (glass or plastic) is visible on the table near the front left of the image.
One desktop computer monitor is visible on a back counter toward the left-center of the image (screen dark).
One yellow propeller- or fin-shaped plastic part is visible on the table toward the left of the central prototype device.
Two framed certificates or awards are mounted on the wall at the right side of the image.
Multiple posters are mounted on the back wall above the counter; at least eight distinct poster panels are visible in a row.
spatial_relations: A central work table occupies the foreground and middle of the image with people gathered around all visible sides of the table.
The large red prototype device lies on the table toward the right-center; a person in a red shirt is standing behind it and pointing at components on its top surface.
The black tool basket is on the table in front of the person in the red shirt, between the camera and the prototype device.
The desktop monitor is positioned on a counter directly behind the people on the left side of the image, beneath a row of posters on the back wall.
Two framed certificates hang on the wall behind the group at the right; the word 'DREAMLab' is displayed above and to the right on a light-coloured wall or glass panel.
A magnifying glass on its stand is near the right-front edge of the table, partially in front of the red prototype device.
People form roughly a semicircle around the table, with at least three people on the left side, the instructor/lead in the center rear, and several observers on the right side.
colours_and_materials: The large prototype device visible on the table is predominantly red.
A noticeable yellow plastic part (propeller- or fin-shaped) is on the table to the left of the red device.
The work surface appears to be a light wood-coloured table.
The back wall area with the DREAMLab sign is light green or pale aqua, appearing as painted wall or glass panel.
The tool basket is black plastic and contains a variety of coloured tools and wires; the magnifier has a black handle or stand.
uncertainties: Exact number of people cannot be determined precisely because several individuals are partially obscured; 'at least ten' is a conservative visible minimum.

Some small printed text on posters and on the whiteboard or wall is not legible at this resolution; only the larger words 'DREAMLab', 'UNIVERSITY OF HONG KONG', 'CERTIFICATE' and '3rd PRIZE' could be transcribed reliably.
The precise content of the framed certificates and most poster captions is unreadable from this view.
The identification of the clear cylindrical container's material (glass or plastic) is uncertain from the image.
The red prototype device is cropped at the right edge of the image so its full shape and any labels on its right side are not visible.
